title.ko: 법과 정의: be convicted of · plead guilty · beyond reasonable doubt · uphold a ruling
title.en: law and justice: be convicted of, plead guilty, beyond reasonable doubt, uphold a ruling

explain.ko: 법과 재판에 관한 영어는 정해진 연어가 중요합니다. 기소(charge with), 유죄 선고(convict of), 무죄 선고(acquit), 유죄 인정(plead guilty), 항소(appeal against), 판결 유지(uphold a ruling), 입증(prove beyond reasonable doubt)이 대표적입니다. 전치사 결합에 주의하세요(convicted of, charged with, appeal against). 뉴스에서는 수동태가 자주 쓰이며, 법적 사실은 단정하지 않고 allegedly, reportedly 같은 부사로 헤징합니다.
explain.en: Legal English relies on fixed collocations: charge with, convict of, acquit, plead guilty, appeal against, uphold a ruling, prove beyond reasonable doubt. Watch the prepositions (convicted of, charged with, appeal against). News often uses the passive, and allegations are hedged with adverbs such as allegedly and reportedly.

lines.t: In a criminal trial, the prosecution must prove the defendant's guilt beyond reasonable doubt. If the evidence is insufficient, the defendant is acquitted. This principle protects the innocent.

trans.ko: 형사 재판에서 검찰은 합리적 의심의 여지 없이 피고인의 유죄를 입증해야 합니다. 증거가 충분하지 않으면 피고인은 무죄가 선고됩니다. 이 원칙은 무고한 사람을 보호하기 위한 것입니다.

prompt.ko: 가상의 재판 사건을 사건·증거·판결·항소 순으로 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences on an imaginary court case: the charge, evidence, verdict, appeal.

task.model: The defendant was charged with fraud but did not plead guilty. The prosecution presented evidence beyond reasonable doubt. The court convicted him and sentenced him to three years in prison. He appealed, but the appeal court upheld the original ruling.

model_trans.ko: 피고인은 사기 혐의로 기소되었으나 유죄를 인정하지 않았습니다. 검찰은 합리적 의심의 여지 없는 증거를 제시했습니다. 법원은 그에게 유죄를 선고하고 징역 3년을 선고했습니다. 피고인은 항소했지만 항소 법원은 원심을 유지했습니다.
model_trans.en: The defendant was charged with fraud but did not plead guilty. The prosecution presented evidence beyond reasonable doubt. The court convicted him and sentenced him to three years in prison. He appealed, but the appeal court upheld the original ruling.
